theorems.name: Submission.cbrg_imRep_glue_disjoint
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M M' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → MeasurableSet M' → M ⊆ M' → M' ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M' ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q) → ∀ (ι : Type) [Countable ι] (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (W A : ι → Set (Euclid P)) (R : (i : ι) → IMRep (W i) k) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P k), IsOpen U → (∀ i, IsOpen (W i)) → (∀ i, W i ⊆ U) → (∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i)) → Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (A i) (A j)) → μ (⋃ i, A i)ᶜ = 0 → (∀ i, μ.restrict (A i) = (R i).measure.restrict (A i)) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ i, ∀ᵐ y ∂(μHE[k].restrict ((R i).carrier ∩ A i)), ξ y = (R i).orient y) → ∃ R' : IMRep U k, R'.carrier = ⋃ i, (R i).carrier ∩ A i ∧ R'.orient = ξ ∧ R'.measure = μ
